title: Saudi Arabian Egg Noodle Bake
description: A unique German-inspired casserole combining Saudi Arabian flavors with traditional egg noodles.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, scramble the eggs and set aside.
In a separate pan, combine the roasted Saudi Arabian spices and breadcrumbs. Cook until lightly toasted.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked noodles, scrambled eggs, and toasted breadcrumbs. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the casserole.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
